frozen_plan.holdout_rule: The holdout is the final 20% of the snapshot's information-time span, floored to the start of the UTC day. The fraction is Phase 25.9's, carried over unchanged so that it predates this dataset. The boundary is computed from the information range alone and is never adjusted after any fold count or model outcome is observed.
